articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin's Thanksgiving gains prove fleeting
articles.snippet: Stocks are broadly higher, but bitcoin has slipped back near $60,000, reversing a turkey day advance.

articles.title: Brazil’s stock exchange teams up with major banks to launch real-pegged stablecoin
articles.snippet: Banco B3 will issue the token, backed one-to-one by reais, and other financial institutions can join from launch.

articles.title: Tether can freeze stolen crypto in minutes. Getting it back can take years.
articles.snippet: Tether says it has returned $1.28 billion in frozen USDT, but victims can wait years to recover their money and face fees of up to 20%.

articles.title: Ethereum's much-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade cleared for December test. Here's what to know
articles.snippet: Developers have agreed to keep the planned storage charges despite concerns about some existing smart contracts, ending seven weeks of delays to the next major test.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
articles.snippet: More bitcoin is sitting untouched onchain as the price holds around $60,000, some 50% below its peak,
